query: How will mandatory-reporting rules be operationalized across jurisdictions to protect participants while preserving confidentiality and research integrity?

response.query: How will mandatory-reporting rules be operationalized across jurisdictions to protect participants while preserving confidentiality and research integrity?
response.answer: Mandatory-reporting rules are implemented through specific regulations to protect participants while ensuring confidentiality and research integrity, balancing disclosure with privacy protections. Key frameworks include the Ryan Haight Act and CIRCIA.

results.title: Advancing Interoperability and Improving Prior ...
results.content: In the December 13, 2022 **Federal Register** (87 FR 76238), we issued the “Medicare and Medicaid Programs; Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act; Advancing Interoperability and Improving Prior Authorization Processes for Medicare Advantage Organizations, Medicaid Managed Care Plans, State Medicaid Agencies, Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) Agencies and CHIP Managed Care Entities, Issuers of Qualified Health Plans on the Federally-Facilitated Exchanges, Merit-Based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) Eligible Clinicians, and Eligible Hospitals and Critical Access Hospitals in the Medicare Promoting Interoperability Program” proposed rule (CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization proposed rule), in which we proposed new requirements for MA, state Medicaid FFS programs, state CHIP FFS programs, Medicaid managed care plans, CHIP managed care entities, and QHP issuers on the FFEs (collectively “impacted payers”) to improve the electronic exchange of health care information and streamline prior authorization for medical items and services.

results.title: Masterclass for Directors Training, New Board Members ...
results.content: It trains & certifies Directors and aspiring Directors as **“Certified Corporate Director”,** which offers great insight on Board Processes, Board Strategic Involvement and also growing focus on the role of Independent Directors, changing regulations - Listing Obligations & Disclosure Requirements (LODR), Companies Act, etc., including a Board simulation exercise to validate & enhance preparedness for the future. The Institute of Directors (IOD) being a globally recognized association of Directors, its objective is to provide its members and Certified Director Alumni with a comprehensive understanding of Indian Company Law and the legal framework governing boards, with a specific emphasis on the duties and responsibilities of Directors operating within India. IOD is an independent apex professional association for Directors and Senior Executives which conducts its flagship training programme ‘Masterclass for Directors’ leading to “Certified Corporate Director” – which is exclusively designed to assist you to pass the online test and address the challenges of the future board by up-skilling the aspiring Directors.
